title: Owner Self-Use Readiness Matrix (PASS 44)
scope: Can ONE owner log in manually, enter business details, review outputs, approve material actions, and perform all real-world implementation manually — with NO live integrations or autonomous external actions?

rows.evidence: src/app/login/page.tsx (/login real form) → /api/auth/login; custom DB session + bcrypt; rate-limited (src/infra/rate-limit.ts)
rows.testCoverage: browser 46-50 log in as owner; auth audit events
rows.ownerImpact: owner can log in with email/password

rows.evidence: workspace created on signup (src/app/api/auth/signup/route.ts); workspace resolved server-side from earliest active membership (src/lib/canonical-route-enforcement.ts); NO in-app switcher
rows.ownerImpact: one workspace per signup; owner cannot switch workspaces in-app
rows.requiredFix: add a workspace switcher only if the owner needs multiple workspaces

rows.evidence: '+ New business' form on every owner domain page → POST /api/owner/recovery/businesses (createBusiness in owner/finance/page.tsx et al.)
rows.ownerImpact: owner can create an OwnerBusiness from the UI

rows.evidence: Data Intake UI at /owner/intake (src/app/(authenticated)/owner/intake/page.tsx) with a Manual-form/CSV/paste form → /api/owner/intake/...; per-domain snapshot forms (e.g. finance addSnapshot). NOTE: the structured single-record endpoint /api/owner/manual-entry is API-ONLY (no UI page posts to it).
rows.ownerImpact: owner enters data via intake (manual form / CSV / paste) + domain snapshot forms; there is no dedicated field-by-field 'log an issue' form wired to /api/owner/manual-entry
rows.requiredFix: wire a simple UI form to /api/owner/manual-entry for structured issue/complaint entry (restriction, not a blocker)
